text: Please make a widescreen fact clip about Voyager 1 using NASA's mission page as the reference: https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ . I've always found this mission fascinating, and I'm a little worried about getting the two Voyager spacecraft mixed up when explaining it. What I have in mind is 9 seconds total, completely silent with no narration, music, or sound effects, split into three equal 3-second scenes showing the probe near Earth, then Jupiter, then Saturn. The scene labels should be exactly 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979', and 'Saturn flyby: 1980', in that order. Please also keep the exact labels 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout, so those and the three scene labels are the five supplied labels to use. The visual style is up to you as long as the planets are recognizable and the probe matches its real dish-and-boom design, and please don't mix in Voyager 2's Uranus or Neptune visits.
